bullets.text: U.S. equities finished mixed as **tech weakness weighed on the Nasdaq (-0.62%) and S&P 500 (-0.25%)**, with **Nvidia (-2.68%)** and **Amazon (-2.19%)** sliding while **Meta (+3.83%)**, the **Dow (+0.33%)**, and **Russell 2000 (+0.71%)** gained amid **Extreme Fear (15.0)**.
A federal judge ruled the **FCC violated ABC's First Amendment rights** by moving to review local broadcast licenses, while the **White House proposed new tariffs** on major U.S. trading partners.

The **FCC approved SpaceX's plan to deploy 1 million satellites** for orbital data centers despite scientist skepticism, while budget carrier **Norse Atlantic suspended all flights** amid bankruptcy risk.

North Korean leader *Kim Jong Un* vowed to **expand nuclear weapons production**, while **Israeli strikes in Gaza killed eight** including a Hamas official and **Congo's Ebola outbreak reached 12,000 cases**.

A **cheaper twice-yearly HIV prevention injection (lenacapavir)** with near-100% efficacy began reaching Africa, and **ESA's Hera spacecraft** returned close-up imagery of NASA's asteroid deflection crater.

U.S. equities held a **mixed close** with the **Nasdaq (-0.62%)** and **S&P 500 (-0.25%)** trailing the **Dow (+0.33%)** and **Russell 2000 (+0.71%)**, while **WTI crude climbed 1.83% to $85.21**, **gold rose 1.42% to $3,586.10**, and the **VIX eased 5.27% to 26.80**.
**Nvidia paused AI chip shipments to Southeast Asia** and instructed buyers to rule out Chinese renters, halting **billions in data center deals** under U.S. export curbs.

Severe **Thanksgiving coastal storms knocked out power to nearly 1 million U.S. customers**, grounded flights at Reagan National Airport, and forced the **postponement of the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade**.

A **strike in Kuwait killed two Italian Rheinmetall technicians**, which Iranian Foreign Minister *Abbas Araghchi* called "suspicious," while Ukrainian President *Volodymyr Zelensky* told the BBC the U.S. is **not pushing Russia hard enough**.

top_news.headline: Nvidia Pauses AI Chip Shipments to Southeast Asia Amid Export Curbs
top_news.summary: Nvidia has instructed partners to pause AI chip shipments to Southeast Asia and told buyers they must rule out Chinese renters to purchase GPUs. The move has stalled billions of dollars in regional data center deals as U.S. semiconductor restrictions tighten.
top_news.why_it_matters: Southeast Asia has been a major growth hub for AI infrastructure, and stricter enforcement of U.S. chip curbs directly threatens Nvidia's regional demand and cloud capacity expansion.

top_news.headline: Major Thanksgiving Storms Cut Power to Nearly 1 Million, Disrupt U.S. Travel
top_news.summary: Powerful coastal storms battered both U.S. coasts on Thanksgiving, bringing heavy rain, flooding, and high winds that left nearly one million customers without electricity by Thursday evening. The severe weather grounded flights at Washington's Reagan National Airport and forced the postponement of the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.
top_news.why_it_matters: Widespread power outages and flight disruptions are complicating holiday travel for an estimated 81.5 million Americans and straining East Coast infrastructure.

top_news.headline: Strike in Kuwait Kills Two Italian Technicians as Iran Denies Responsibility
top_news.summary: Two Italian technicians working for German defense firm Rheinmetall were killed in a strike in Kuwait, according to Italy's foreign ministry. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi denied responsibility, calling the deadly incident "suspicious" and a "pre-cooked recipe" for war.
top_news.why_it_matters: The deaths of European defense contractors in the Gulf heighten the risk of broader regional escalation and further rattle energy markets.

top_news.headline: Argentina Bars Central Bank From Printing Money to Fund Government Spending
top_news.summary: Argentina enacted a measure prohibiting its central bank from printing money to finance government spending, reinforcing fiscal discipline efforts. Separately, the country's Senate advanced a proposal to suspend primary elections ahead of the 2027 presidential race.
top_news.why_it_matters: Cutting off monetary financing of the fiscal deficit is a pivotal structural shift aimed at anchoring inflation expectations in South America's second-largest economy.

top_news.headline: FCC Approves SpaceX Plan for 1 Million Orbital Data Center Satellites
top_news.summary: The Federal Communications Commission has **authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million satellites** designed to host data centers in orbit. Scientists and astronomers have **voiced skepticism** over the technical feasibility and orbital congestion risks of the massive constellation.
top_news.why_it_matters: Approving a constellation of this scale **dramatically expands commercial orbital infrastructure** while intensifying regulatory debates over **space debris and spectrum crowding**.

top_news.headline: Norse Atlantic Suspends All Flights Amid Urgent Funding Plea
top_news.summary: Budget transatlantic carrier **Norse Atlantic Airways suspended all flights** on Thanksgiving Day as it **flagged potential bankruptcy risk**. The five-year-old airline is making an urgent plea for emergency financing to stay afloat.
top_news.why_it_matters: The sudden halt underscores **persistent financial fragility among low-cost long-haul carriers** and strands **peak holiday travelers** across transatlantic routes.

top_news.headline: Federal Judge Rules FCC Violated ABC's First Amendment Rights
top_news.summary: A U.S. federal judge **blocked the Trump administration from reviewing local broadcast licenses** held by ABC across six of the nation's largest markets. The court ruled that the FCC **violated ABC's free speech rights** by attempting to punish the network over satire.
top_news.why_it_matters: The ruling establishes a **key judicial check on executive broadcast regulation** and reinforces **First Amendment protections** for television networks.

top_news.headline: White House Proposes New Tariffs on Major U.S. Trading Partners
top_news.summary: President *Donald Trump*'s administration has **proposed new tariffs on imports from major U.S. trading partners**, aiming to counter what it describes as structural overcapacity. The proposal has already **drawn sharp opposition from Democrats** including Sen. *Tim Kaine* and free-trade advocates.
top_news.why_it_matters: Fresh tariff threats risk **reigniting global trade friction** and **raising input costs for U.S. importers and consumers**.

top_news.headline: Kim Jong Un Vows to Expand Nuclear Arsenal, Ignoring U.S. Overture
top_news.summary: North Korean leader *Kim Jong Un* **inspected nuclear material production facilities** and called for **building more nuclear weapons** to counter perceived threats from the U.S. and South Korea. The remarks came after Pyongyang ignored *Donald Trump*'s recent diplomatic overture.
top_news.why_it_matters: Accelerated fissile-material production **raises regional deterrence pressures** across Northeast Asia and signals **little near-term appetite for denuclearization talks**.

top_news.headline: ESA's Hera Mission Captures Chaotic Aftermath of Asteroid Deflection Test
top_news.summary: The European Space Agency's **Hera spacecraft returned close-up images** revealing a **stadium-size crater** left by NASA's first planetary defense asteroid deflection experiment. Scientists described the impact site as a chaotic debris field.
top_news.why_it_matters: Detailed post-impact data **validates kinetic-impactor modeling** and improves **global readiness for future planetary defense missions**.

top_news.headline: 42 State Attorneys General Move to Block Character.AI User Chat Sale
top_news.summary: A **coalition of 42 state attorneys general** is seeking to **stop Character.AI from selling user data** during its Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings. The officials allege the company plans to auction off private chat histories belonging to more than 21 million users.
top_news.why_it_matters: The legal intervention tests **consumer privacy limits in tech bankruptcies** and sets a precedent for **how AI platforms handle sensitive user conversation logs**.

top_news.headline: Cheaper Twice-Yearly HIV Prevention Injection Reaches Africa
top_news.summary: A **lower-cost version of lenacapavir**, a twice-yearly injection shown to be **nearly 100% effective at preventing HIV infection**, has begun reaching countries in Africa. Public health groups say the rollout could protect millions of high-risk individuals.
top_news.why_it_matters: Expanding affordable access to **long-acting HIV prophylaxis** marks a major milestone toward **curbing new infections in high-burden regions**.

top_news.headline: Congo Ebola Outbreak Reaches 12,000 Cases Amid Rebel Fighting
top_news.summary: An **Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has reached 12,000 cases**, forcing some medical responders to evacuate. Ongoing **fighting between rebel groups and the army** continues to hamper containment and treatment efforts.
top_news.why_it_matters: Armed conflict around outbreak zones **severely undermines contact tracing and vaccination**, raising the risk of **wider regional transmission**.

markets.narrative: Equities finished **mixed** as **Nvidia (-2.68%)** and **Amazon (-2.19%)** dragged the **Nasdaq (-0.62%)** and **S&P 500 (-0.25%)** lower, while **Meta (+3.83%)** and **Materials (+2.07%)** helped lift the **Dow (+0.33%)** and **Russell 2000 (+0.71%)**. In extended commodities and rates trading, **WTI crude climbed 1.83% to $85.21** and **gold held up 1.42% at $3,586.10** amid Middle East tensions, while the **10-year yield stood at 4.85%** and the **VIX fell 5.27% to 26.80** despite **Extreme Fear (15.0)**.

conflicts.overview: Global conflict intensity **remained elevated across major theaters**, led by ongoing **high-tempo fighting in Ukraine** and **renewed Gaza strikes alongside US-Iran escalation fears** in the Middle East. Meanwhile, **Indo-Pacific deterrence posture tightened** around Taiwan and **Yemen-linked spillover** deepened in the Red Sea and Horn of Africa.

legislative_and_executive.title: Federal Court Blocks FCC Review of ABC Broadcast Licenses
legislative_and_executive.summary: A federal judge **barred the FCC from reviewing local ABC broadcast licenses**, ruling the agency **violated First Amendment free speech rights** over network satire.

legislative_and_executive.title: White House Proposes New Tariffs on Major Trading Partners
legislative_and_executive.summary: The Trump administration **proposed broad new tariffs** targeting major U.S. trading partners, prompting **immediate pushback from Senate Democrats** and free-trade advocates.

legislative_and_executive.title: Congress Weighs Iran War Funding Restrictions in Budget Bill
legislative_and_executive.summary: Lawmakers are considering **budget bill restrictions to curb U.S. military operations against Iran**, a move that could **trigger a government shutdown**.

legislative_and_executive.title: Court Allows Puerto Rico to Terminate LUMA Energy Grid Contract
legislative_and_executive.summary: A court ruling **nullified LUMA Energy's power grid contract**, giving Puerto Rico's governor **one year to select a new operator**.

trending_topics.framing_note: Administration officials frame the **new tariffs as a response to structural overcapacity**, while critics warn of **higher consumer prices and retaliatory trade friction**.

trending_topics.topic: Nvidia CEO Reinstatement & National Security Probe
trending_topics.framing_note: Republicans are demanding **FBI and CIA briefings** before questioning *Jensen Huang*, while 2028 Democrats **frame the White House's involvement as corporate favoritism**.
Press-freedom advocates hail the **injunction blocking ABC license reviews** as a vital constitutional check on **regulatory retaliation**.
Senate Democrats are **pushing to add freshmen to leadership** after November gains, while **RNC leadership faces internal challenges** over midterm losses.

positive_news.headline: Infant Given Weeks to Live Is Now Brain Cancer-Free After St. Jude Trial
positive_news.summary: An infant girl who had been **given only weeks to live on Christmas Eve** due to aggressive brain cancer has made a **full recovery**. Her family sent her case to 15 institutions before it reached St. Jude Children's Hospital, which had just completed a rigorous clinical study on her specific cancer.
positive_news.why_it_matters: The recovery highlights how **targeted pediatric oncology trials** and rapid institutional collaboration can **turn terminal diagnoses into survivable outcomes**.

positive_news.headline: 126 Acres of Cape Cod Salt Marsh Returned to Indigenous Ownership After 400 Years
positive_news.summary: The Nature Conservancy has **transferred roughly 126 acres of salt marsh and coastal habitat** in Eastham, Massachusetts to the **Indigenous-led Native Land Conservancy**. The handover returns ancestral land near Cape Cod to Native American stewardship more than four centuries after European settlers first arrived in the area.
positive_news.why_it_matters: Expanding **Indigenous-led land conservation** pairs cultural restoration with **long-term protection of fragile coastal ecosystems**.

positive_news.headline: Texas Town Raises Over $27,000 to Gift New Car to Woman Who Feeds 2,000 Every Thanksgiving
positive_news.summary: After **37 years of cooking annual Thanksgiving meals for 2,000 neighbors**, Texas resident *Gloria Kennard* was surprised by her community with a **brand-new car funded by more than $27,000 in local donations**. Residents organized the fundraiser quietly while she prepared this year's holiday dinner.
positive_news.why_it_matters: The grassroots fundraiser underscores how **sustained neighborhood generosity** builds **durable civic solidarity**.

stories.headline: Monster King Tides Flood Bay Area Coastline
stories.summary: High **king tide waves battered the California coast**, causing **localized flooding across parts of San Francisco** and low-lying Bay Area shorelines. Forecasters issued exact peak-tide timing alerts as coastal communities braced for surge impacts.
stories.why_it_matters: Seasonal king tides **expose vulnerable Bay Area coastal infrastructure** and preview **long-term sea-level rise risks**.

stories.headline: More U.S. Tech Startups Look to Shenzhen Over Silicon Valley
stories.summary: A growing number of **American hardware and tech startups are relocating operations** from Silicon Valley to China's Shenzhen. Founders cite **faster prototyping supply chains and lower operating costs** as key drivers.
stories.why_it_matters: The shift underscores **intensifying global competition for hardware talent** despite ongoing U.S.-China trade and tech tensions.

stories.headline: Anaheim Ducks Cruise Past San Jose Sharks to Snap 4-Game Skid
stories.summary: The **Anaheim Ducks defeated the San Jose Sharks** behind a strong offensive performance from *Cutter Gauthier*. The win **snapped Anaheim's four-game losing streak** while handing San Jose another home setback.
stories.why_it_matters: The result **slows the Sharks' momentum** in Pacific Division play heading into the holiday weekend.

stories.headline: San Jose Community Builders Highlighted in Thanksgiving Tributes
stories.summary: Local commentators in San Jose **spotlighted neighborhood organizers and small-business owners** supporting residents this Thanksgiving. Separately, a San Jose cafe was credited with **helping a local man rebuild his life** through second-chance employment.
stories.why_it_matters: Grassroots civic networks continue to **strengthen social safety nets** across Silicon Valley amid high living costs.

stories.headline: 四大商业银行已签订超6000亿元股票回购增持贷款合同
stories.summary: 中国人民银行等部门将**股票回购增持再贷款转为长期制度性安排**并下调利率后，工、农、中、建四大商业银行迅速加大投放力度。截至目前，四大行已与上市公司**签订贷款合同超6000亿元人民币**。
stories.why_it_matters: 长期化、低利率的再贷款支持有助于**稳定A股市场流动性**，并为**上市公司市值管理提供持续资金保障**。

stories.headline: 特朗普深圳会晤一周后再提关税威胁 对华税率或达40%
stories.summary: 白宫针对贸易伙伴所谓“结构性产能过剩”**再度提出加征关税**，对华税率最高可达40%。经济学家警告，关税成本最终由美国进口企业承担，若**转嫁给消费者将推高物价并抑制全球贸易**。
stories.why_it_matters: 中美高层会晤后迅速再现关税摩擦，**加剧了双边经贸前景的不确定性**，并给**全球供应链带来新的成本压力**。

stories.headline: 2026年中国增材制造产业规模预计达约860亿元
stories.summary: 在四川泸州开幕的2026增材制造大会发布的报告显示，今年**中国3D打印产业规模预计达到约860亿元人民币**。该产业在高端制造与工业应用领域的**渗透率正持续提升**。
stories.why_it_matters: 增材制造规模扩大反映出**中国先进制造业升级加快**，有助于**提升精密零部件与定制化生产能力**。

stories.headline: 成都残疾男子绿灯过街被撞身亡引发交通无障碍热议
stories.summary: 成都一名腿部残疾男子在通过**仅设12秒绿灯的34米宽马路**时，因红灯亮起后加速通行，不幸被绿灯直行摩托车撞倒身亡。事件引发舆论呼吁**城市交通信号设计应兼顾弱势群体通行时间**。
stories.why_it_matters: 这起悲剧凸显了**城市基础设施无障碍化与人行信号配时优化的紧迫性**，推动各地**重新审视适老化与残障友好交通标准**。

stories_en.headline: China's Big Four Banks Sign Over 600 Billion Yuan in Share Buyback Loans
stories_en.summary: After the People's Bank of China and regulators **converted share-buyback relending into a permanent institutional tool** and cut rates, ICBC, ABC, BOC, and CCB rapidly expanded lending. The four major banks have now **signed over 600 billion yuan in buyback and stake-increase loan contracts** with listed firms.
stories_en.why_it_matters: Permanent, lower-cost relending support helps **stabilize A-share market liquidity** and provides **sustained capital backing for corporate valuation management**.

stories_en.headline: Trump Threatens Up to 40% China Tariffs One Week After Shenzhen Summit
stories_en.summary: The White House **proposed fresh tariffs targeting structural overcapacity**, with rates on Chinese goods potentially reaching 40%. Economists warn that U.S. importers bear the tariff cost and that **passing it to consumers could stoke inflation and curb global trade**.
stories_en.why_it_matters: Renewed tariff friction shortly after high-level talks **heightens bilateral trade uncertainty** and adds **fresh cost pressures to global supply chains**.

stories_en.headline: China's 3D Printing Industry Projected to Reach 86 Billion Yuan in 2026
stories_en.summary: A report released at the 2026 Additive Manufacturing Conference in Luzhou, Sichuan, projects **China's 3D printing sector will reach about 86 billion yuan** this year. Adoption of the technology **continues to expand across high-end manufacturing and industrial applications**.
stories_en.why_it_matters: Rapid growth in additive manufacturing reflects **accelerating industrial upgrading in China**, strengthening **precision component and customized production capabilities**.

stories_en.headline: Fatal Crosswalk Crash in Chengdu Sparks Debate on Accessible Traffic Timing
stories_en.summary: A man with a leg disability in Chengdu was fatally struck by a motorcycle after accelerating across a **34-meter road with only a 12-second green light**. The incident has prompted **public calls for traffic signal timing that accommodates vulnerable pedestrians**.
stories_en.why_it_matters: The tragedy underscores the **urgency of accessible urban infrastructure and pedestrian signal reform**, pushing cities to **reassess elderly- and disability-friendly transit standards**.
